description: PROP-BILL-065 (PAY.JP API encoding) at subscribe-flow.test.ts:812-823 still only verifies that mock methods were called (fetchToken, createCustomer, createCharge, createSubscription). It asserts nothing about encoding format (form-urlencoded vs JSON). The test comment acknowledges 'encoding is the responsibility of the client implementation' but the contract CRIT does not exist for this proof obligation. REQ-BILL-034 remains unverifiable at the shell integration test level because the DI boundary abstracts away the encoding. The contract should either (a) add a CRIT covering the PayjpClient implementation's encoding or (b) explicitly defer PROP-BILL-065 to Tier 3 manual verification.
